1.consolidated_definition: Arbusto de hasta 6 m de altura, con corteza oscura, hojas pequeñas redondeadas y flores blancas en racimos. (Erythroxylaceae, Erythroxylum areolatum).
1.en_consolidated_definition: Shrub reaching up to 6 meters in height, with dark bark, small rounded leaves and white flowers in clusters (Erythroxylaceae, Erythroxylum areolatum).
